title: 第25章 听到了不该听的话第26章 被殃及池鱼
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: 啪！
郑玉凤费劲的举起另一只手向郑元脸上打了过去。
郑元脸上露出一丝微笑，自然一把给抓住了。
“玉凤姐，你的伤我能治好，还能继续修炼。”
“胡说八道，医师都看过了，我再也不能修炼了。”
郑玉凤气的柳眉倒竖，这个族弟无非就是想吃自己的豆腐。
郑玉凤身材娇小玲珑，凹凸有致，容颜清秀。
在郑族里也算得上一个大美女，本来不能修炼就已经心如死灰，如今又被一个男人闯进闺房，轻薄自己，郑玉凤眼角的眼泪都出来了。
郑元也无语了，当然也把手松开了。
刚才就是替郑玉凤把把脉，探一下伤势。
“你要不信我就走了，不过以后就真不能修炼了。”
郑元转身而去，就在要出房门时，后面传来一道声音：“真的？”
“真的，我可以先帮你把断骨接上，不过过程中稍微有些疼，至于断裂的经脉需要炼制一枚蕴灵丹吃下就会好了。”
郑玉凤听到这话犹豫了一会还是点头同意了。
不过下一刻俏脸变得通红一片，那就是郑元要把自己胸前衣服解开。
作为一个未出阁的女子，即使郑元是族弟，但毕竟是一个男子。
如果被他又看又摸，以后还怎么见人。
郑元脸上露出一丝苦笑：“玉凤姐，我修为太低，还达不到隔空御物的境界，何况接骨稍微有一丝差错就算失败了。”
刚才郑元在给郑玉凤看过伤势后就在乾坤珠里搜索了起来。
那里面还真有一篇高明的接骨法，名字叫做“玲珑手”。
把碎骨那里用内力震碎，然后再进行重新融合。
郑玉凤咬着嘴唇最后还是同意了，因为不能修炼自己就成了一个废人。
如果郑元是在敷衍自己，那么自己就咬舌自尽。
“玉凤姐，用不着这么吧，在医生的眼里只有病人，并没有男女之别，这件事我也不会告诉别人的。”
郑元嘴里说着安慰的话，当然下一刻也不禁心神荡漾。
郑玉凤的肌肤白皙粉嫩，尤其是前面波澜壮阔。
这一点还真没想到，毕竟女子因为练功经常把胸前束的很紧。
此时郑玉凤已经羞得闭上了眼睛，娇躯颤抖中。
毕竟从来没有让一个男子碰过自己，身体里犹如一道电流划过。
这样不行，对方必须要一动不动才可以，否则一丝颤抖都会影响接骨的效果。
“玉凤姐，得罪了。”
郑元一指点出，封住了郑玉凤的穴道，当然还没有忘了把一块布放到她的嘴里。
一个时辰过后，郑元收回了双手，擦了擦头上的汗水。
毕竟也是第一次使用“玲珑手”接骨法，不过好在完美成功了。
“咦？真的不疼了！”
下床后的郑玉凤舒展了一下身体，发现胸前一点都不疼了。
“玉凤姐，炼制蕴灵丹还需要一阵子，你断骨刚接上，还是要静养几天，不要用力，我先走了。”
看来十万大山是必须要再去一次了。
郑元转身而去，屋里的郑玉凤张着嘴欲言又止。
content_en:
Snap!
Zheng Yufeng struggled to raise her other hand and hit Zheng Yuan in the face.
Zheng Yuan showed a smile on his face and naturally caught it.
"Sister Yufeng, I can heal your injuries and you can continue to practice."
"It's nonsense. The doctors have seen it. I can no longer practice."
Zheng Yufeng's eyebrows stood up in anger, this clan brother just wanted to eat his own tofu.
Zheng Yufeng has a petite and exquisite figure, well-proportioned features, and a delicate face.
She was considered a great beauty among the Zheng clan. She was already devastated because she could not practice cultivation. Now that a man broke into her boudoir and despised her, tears came from the corners of Zheng Yufeng's eyes.
Zheng Yuan was speechless, and of course he let go of his hand.
Just now I was taking Zheng Yufeng's pulse and exploring his injuries.
"If you don't believe me, I'll leave, but I won't be able to practice anymore."
Zheng Yuan turned around and left. Just as he was about to leave the room, a voice came from behind: "Really?"
"Really, I can help you reconnect the broken bones first, but it will be a little painful in the process. As for the broken meridians, you need to refine a spirit-accumulating pill and eat it and it will be fine."
After hearing this, Zheng Yufeng hesitated for a while but nodded in agreement.
But the next moment her pretty face turned red, that was when Zheng Yuan was about to take off the clothes on her chest.
As a woman who has not left the court, even though Zheng Yuan is a clan brother, she is still a man.
If you are looked at and touched by him, how will you see anyone in the future?
A wry smile appeared on Zheng Yuan's face: "Sister Yufeng, my cultivation level is too low and I can't reach the realm of controlling objects through space. Besides, if there is even a slight mistake in bone setting, it will be a failure."
Just now, Zheng Yuan started searching in the Qiankun Pearl after showing Zheng Yufeng his injuries.
There is indeed a brilliant bone-setting method in it, called "Linglong Hands".
Use internal force to crush the broken bones, and then re-fuse them.
Zheng Yufeng bit her lip and finally agreed, because she would become a useless person if she couldn't cultivate herself.
If Zheng Yuan was perfunctory with himself, then he would bite his tongue and commit suicide.
"Sister Yufeng, there is no need to be like this. In the eyes of doctors, there are only patients, and there is no difference between men and women. I will not tell others about this."
Zheng Yuan said comforting words, and of course he couldn't help but feel excited the next moment.
Zheng Yufeng's skin is fair and pink, especially the front is magnificent.
I really didn't expect this, after all, women often tie their chests very tightly because of practicing martial arts.
At this time, Zheng Yufeng had closed her eyes in shame, and her delicate body was trembling.
After all, he had never let a man touch him before, and it was like an electric current flashed through his body.
This won't work, the other party must be motionless, otherwise a slight tremor will affect the effect of bone setting.
"Sister Yufeng, I'm offended."
Zheng Yuanyi pointed out and sealed Zheng Yufeng's acupuncture points. Of course, he didn't forget to put a piece of cloth into her mouth.
…
An hour later, Zheng Yuan took back his hands and wiped the sweat from his head.
After all, it was the first time to use the "Linglong Hand" bone setting method, but fortunately it was a perfect success.
"Huh? It really doesn't hurt anymore!"
After getting out of bed, Zheng Yufeng stretched her body and found that her chest no longer hurt at all.
"Sister Yufeng, it will take a while to refine the spirit-accumulating pill. Your broken bones have just been reattached, so you still need to rest for a few days. Don't use force. I'm leaving first."
It seems that Shiwandashan must be visited again.
Zheng Yuan turned around and left. Zheng Yufeng in the room opened her mouth and hesitated to speak.
title_en: Chapter 25: Hearing words that I shouldn’t have heard Chapter 26: Being affected by Chiyu
